functions.name: opModConnect

functions.description: Active power target, value x 10^multiplier watts, discharge positive.

functions.name: opModFixedPFAbsorbW
functions.description: Fixed power factor while absorbing active power; displacement is thousandths.

functions.name: opModFixedVar

functions.name: opModFixedW
functions.description: Active power setpoint in hundredths of a percent, discharge positive.

functions.description: Frequency droop: dead bands dBOF and dBUF in thousandths of a hertz, droops kOF and kUF in thousandths (unitless), open loop response time openLoopTms in hundredths of a second, 0 for no limit.
